name: held-text-reads-a-replacement-string
description: A text that `xargs`, `find` or `parallel` replaces with each path it finds is a part only the run knows in each word of the command it runs, so `xargs -I % node scripts/%` holds every file below `scripts` and makes no finding possible, while `{}` in a command no runtime runs names nothing. A workflow's trigger filter names the files whose change starts it and runs none, so a file only such a filter names is reported at the class certain, and the package has one note for the file it holds.
